text:
Tara (Growth): Heads-up team — prepping a compact newsletter + webinar invite for the July benchmark pieces. Need final subject, segment splits, and a send cadence.
Diego (Events): Webinar invites should go to engaged trial users + dev newsletter list. propose 3 segments: Engaged Trials (S1), Product-Interest (S2), General Newsletter (S3).
Keisha (Design): I'll adapt the hero for the webinar CTA and a shorter hero for the benchmark summary. mobile-first.
Anya (Deliverability): heads-up: last month corporate domains had elevated deferred rates. recommend seeded test group per segment and a suppression sweep.
Tara (Growth): subject tests — please vote:
```
A) Live: Benchmark talk + 3x token savings (register)
B) Join our benchmark webinar — real wins and configs
C) Benchmark recap: latency, cost, and a live Q&A
```
Keisha (Design): i like B for S1 and C for S3. A feels too promotional for developers.
Diego (Events): also want a soft invite in the newsletter and a hard invite to S1 with follow-up reminders (48h and 1h).
Liam (Ops): can we time sends to local mornings? we'll need regional throttles and timezone-aware retry windows.
Anya (Deliverability): propose seeded canaries: 100 users per segment in each region (APAC/EMEA/NA). We'll check spam-trap hits, auth (DKIM/SPF) propagation, and opens.
Tara (Growth): good. CTA links: primary -> /events/benchmark-july (register). secondary -> /blog/benchmark-summary. keep utm=nl_july.
Keisha (Design): trimming subject lengths: A=60 chars, B=56, C=58. we'll push mobile under 50 if necessary.
Anya (Deliverability): headers to add to canary sends:
```
X-Redwood-Canary: true
List-Unsubscribe: <https://redwood.example.com/unsub>
```
Anya (Deliverability): also enable click-wrapping and set TTL 72h for APAC links.
Tara (Growth): segmentation rules: S1 = active trials last 30d + >2 api calls/day; S2 = engaged docs opens last 90d; S3 = remainder. any flags?
Diego (Events): for S1, we should include a calendar .ics attach. for S2/S3 keep it link-first.
Liam (Ops): schedule: canary Tue 09:00 PT; reports due 30m after completion. Full split send Thu — APAC morning, EMEA late morning, NA early morning PT.
deploy-bot: canary-send: id=canary-3020012345 users=900 segments=3 time=2024-07-09T16:00:00Z
deploy-bot: scheduled send created (canary-3020012345) ✅
Tara (Growth): after canary we'll look at open rate, CTR to register, bounce clusters, and one-minute deliverability flags. If S1 shows >20% CTR we'll promote a follow-up reminder to non-openers.
Anya (Deliverability): will post a canary summary in this thread with deliverability score and any suppression updates.
Keisha (Design): i'll export the final templates and add the .ics for S1. ping me when canary is done and i'll run the heatmap.
Diego (Events): reminder — webinar CTAs should mention live Q&A and a short technical demo to lift registration.
Tara (Growth): locking decisions for now. final review Mon 5pm PT. Thanks!
